title: 17 Day Kenya Birding Expedition
rank_math_title: Kenya Birding Expedition: 17 Amazing Days Across Kenya
rank_math_desc: Kenya birding expedition for 17 days: Mount Kenya, Samburu, Nakuru, Baringo, Kakamega, Lake Victoria, the Masai Mara and Naivasha. Price on request.
post_content: This Kenya birding expedition is our longest Kenyan birding route, built for keen listers who want the north, west and south in one trip.
overview:
This Kenya birding expedition runs for 17 days and visits every major birding region in Kenya except the coast. It is ideal from October to December, when migrants from Europe and Asia arrive and the rains turn the land green.

The route starts with Mount Kenya's forests, moves into the dry north, crosses the Rift Valley, spends three nights in Kakamega and finishes with the Masai Mara and Lake Naivasha.

Why choose this Kenya birding expedition?

  • Thika and Mount Kenya: Hinde's babbler, Hartlaub's turaco and Ayres's hawk-eagle.
  • Samburu and Buffalo Springs: Somali specials, sandgrouse and pygmy falcon.
  • Nakuru and Baringo: flamingos, pelicans, owls and Heuglin's courser.
  • Kakamega: three nights in Kenya's only rainforest.
  • Masai Mara: three nights for raptors, cranes, longclaws and big cats.

Where you stay

Lodges include Nairobi Safari Club, Castle Forest Lodge, Samburu Lodge, Naro Moru River Lodge, Sarova Lion Hill, Soi Lodge, Rondo Retreat, Mara Serena Lodge, Mara Sentrim Camp and Lake Naivasha Country Club, or similar.

Best time for a Kenya birding expedition

October to December is ideal for migrants and breeding colours. January to March is also excellent. In the dry season from June to September, birding is easier but fewer migrants are present.

Prefer something shorter? Try our 5 day Kenya birding safari. Read the Masai Mara entrance fee guide and browse all birding safaris. Nature Kenya has more on Kenya's key birding sites.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Nairobi
itinerary.content: Airport pick-up and transfer to Nairobi Safari Club.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Thika to Mount Kenya
itinerary.content: Bird the Blue Post grounds, Chania River and Wajee Camp for Hinde's babbler and turacos, then continue to Castle Forest Lodge on Mount Kenya.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Mount Kenya to Samburu
itinerary.content: Early birding at Castle Forest, then drive north to Samburu Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Samburu National Reserve
itinerary.content: A full day along the Ewaso Ng'iro River for bateleurs, hornbills, sandgrouse and Somali buntings.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Buffalo Springs to Naro Moru
itinerary.content: Morning in Buffalo Springs for pygmy falcon and Somali ostrich, a stop in Meru Forest, then Naro Moru River Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Mount Kenya to Lake Nakuru
itinerary.content: Climb towards the Met Station for Jackson's francolin, then drive to Lake Nakuru. Overnight at Sarova Lion Hill.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.title: Lake Nakuru to Lake Baringo
itinerary.content: Morning at Nakuru, then north to Soi Lodge at Lake Baringo.

itinerary.label: Day 8
itinerary.title: Lake Baringo
itinerary.content: A full day on the lake and cliffs for white-faced owl, nightjars and Jackson's hornbill.

itinerary.label: Day 9
itinerary.title: Kerio Valley to Kakamega
itinerary.content: Birding stops in the Kerio Valley on the way to Rondo Retreat.

itinerary.label: Day 10
itinerary.title: Kakamega Forest
itinerary.content: A full day of rainforest birding for great blue turaco and casqued hornbills.

itinerary.label: Day 11
itinerary.title: Kakamega Forest
itinerary.content: More forest trails for flufftails, trogons and bee-eaters, plus primates.

itinerary.label: Day 12
itinerary.title: Lake Victoria to the Masai Mara
itinerary.content: Morning in the papyrus near Kisumu, then a long drive to the Masai Mara. Overnight at Mara Serena Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 13
itinerary.title: Masai Mara
itinerary.content: A full day of birding and game drives for secretary birds, crowned cranes and big cats.

itinerary.label: Day 14
itinerary.title: Mara River and Hippo Pools
itinerary.content: Cross the Mara River, visit Hippo Pools and bird the bushy hills. Overnight at Mara Sentrim Camp.

itinerary.label: Day 15
itinerary.title: Siana to Lake Naivasha
itinerary.content: Morning birding near Siana, then drive to Lake Naivasha Country Club.

itinerary.label: Day 16
itinerary.title: Lake Naivasha to Nairobi
itinerary.content: Boat trip on Lake Naivasha, then birding at Kinangop, Gatamaiyu and Limuru. Overnight at Nairobi Safari Club.

itinerary.label: Day 17
itinerary.title: Nairobi National Park and departure
itinerary.content: Morning birding and a search for black rhino in Nairobi National Park, then transfer to the airport.
